headline: Binance users pulled about $3.6B on the first day withdrawals reopened, by Binance's own count, as hackers keep moving stolen funds and traders look to Tuesday's US midterms.

stories.title: Binance reopens withdrawals; about $3.6B net leaves on day one, by Binance's count
stories.summary: Binance began a phased reopening of withdrawals at 06:00 UTC Sunday, after halting them following the 29 Oct hack. Its own figures show $4.65B withdrawn and $1.01B deposited between 06:00 and 15:30 UTC, a net outflow of about $3.64B, or 2.1% of its stated $171B in assets. Outside trackers give different numbers. Other networks reopen later, with no date yet.
points: Binance's numbers (06:00-15:30 UTC): $4.65B out, $1.01B in, net about $3.64B, per Blockonomi.

Outside estimates differ: DefiLlama data cited by Reuters puts outflows at $4.36B; TheStreet, reading DefiLlama, reports $3.74B over 24 hours. Binance co-CEO Yi He says trackers may be counting new hot-wallet addresses as outflows.
Binance says company funds have replaced 95% of the affected amount, per Forbes. These are Binance's own figures.
Remaining networks reopen once ready, in order of user demand; deposits stayed open throughout.
The zero-knowledge proof of reserves (a public check that customer balances are fully backed) is scheduled for 3 Nov, per Cointribune.

sources.label: Reuters via Lufkin Daily News: DefiLlama outflows

stories.title: North Korea money trail: $242M laundered through Tron routes as FBI presses swap services
stories.summary: The hackers keep converting stolen coins and moving them through decentralized swap services, which makes them harder to freeze. The FBI has asked THORChain node operators and other services to block listed addresses; the request is voluntary. Elliptic says $2.85B is frozen or seized, but about $3.25B sits in assets that cannot be frozen.
points: Elliptic, via The Block: $2.85B frozen or seized, about 44% of the $6.43B stolen; about $3.25B in unfreezable assets, including 18,327 BTC.
About $242M of Binance loot on Tron was laundered in two days through Relay, THORChain, Chainflip and Symbiosis, per an analyst cited by The Block. Tether froze 378.7M USDT of it.
Lookonchain says the hacker is swapping 970,522 SOL (about $95.9M) into BTC, partly via Relay, per crypto.news.
Separately, THORChain paused swaps on 12 of its 13 chains for hours after a glitch caused a 10 ETH double refund; no attack was found, per Bitcoin.com News.

sources.label: Bitcoin.com News: THORChain and the FBI

stories.title: Markets calm ahead of Tuesday's midterms; crypto PACs spent nearly $170M
stories.summary: Most major coins moved less than 1% on Sunday, with bitcoin near $78,000, about 5% below Thursday's pre-hack high. Tuesday 3 Nov brings the US midterm vote, which shapes who writes crypto market rules.
points: Bitcoin about $78,000 and most majors moved less than 1% on Sunday, per Bloomberg.
Last ETF day (30 Oct): spot bitcoin ETFs -$643.33M, ending four days of inflows; spot ether ETFs about -$156M, a fifth straight outflow day, per SoSoValue via Yahoo Finance.
Three crypto super PACs spent nearly $170M, with Fairshake and affiliates at $154M, per CoinDesk.
Big crypto bills would still need 60 Senate votes, per CoinDesk. Sen. Lummis is citing the hack to push the CLARITY Act, per Blockonomi.

briefs.title: Strategy hints at another buy
briefs.summary: Michael Saylor posted "We found room for even more orange"; Strategy last reported 848,517 BTC. No purchase has been announced, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Stablecoin supply dips
briefs.summary: Total stablecoin supply fell $3.1B since 28 Oct to $298.5B, below its 2026 high of $315.5B, per TokenPost.

briefs.title: Trump on the hack
briefs.summary: Asked about the Binance hack on 31 Oct, President Trump said "We're looking into it. I'm not worried," per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Ether funding rates low
briefs.summary: ETH funding rates are at their lowest since June, and about 35.9% of supply is staked per CryptoQuant, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Moscow Exchange to list crypto
briefs.summary: The Moscow Exchange plans BTC, ETH and USDT trading from 1 Dec, with retail buyers capped at 300,000 rubles a year per broker, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: China targets crypto corruption
briefs.summary: A Communist Party resolution published 1 Nov orders a crackdown on corruption through virtual currency and blockchain; it adds no new trading ban, per crypto.news.
